title: Building Socio-Affective Artificial Intelligence for Interactive Multi-Agent Simulations
summary: The objective of this article is to provide design principles and a software architecture for enabling interaction between humans and multiple agents in simulated dynamic worlds. This connects the current era of general artificial intelligence (AI/AGI) with the proliferation of transformer-based conversational agents and the increased computational capabilities.
